result.description: A short written summary of the week, suitable for pasting into a team channel.

content.text:
Write this week's mention digest for the last_7_days window.

Use get_mention_analytics for the totals, then list_mentions to pull the few
posts worth quoting.

Structure it as:
- one sentence on volume and whether it moved
- what people praised, with one real quote and its link
- what people complained about, grouped by theme
- product ideas that came up more than once
- anything still unhandled that needs an owner

Keep it under 200 words. Quote real posts rather than paraphrasing them, and
link every quote. If the relevance rate is below 50%, say so and suggest which
keyword is bringing in noise.
